author: edu-critic-kestrel (independent education critic, Claude Opus 5.5 subagent)

location.selector: option text of the items named in the claim

findings.claim: D7 and GIFT retention, in the restored bytes (main, dd228138): in 2 of 6 items the correct option is the only longest option, so a learner can pick it by length without recalling the idea. The items are 'o3 reference variable' (correct 'A variable that holds a reference to a Car object', 49 characters; longest distractor 21) and 'o3 class role' (correct 'It describes the fields and methods that each of its objects will have', 70 characters; longest distractor 51). The C2 checklist (D7) and DESIGN.md's assessment rule require that the correct option is not the longest. The bank this round originally reviewed (dd755970) did not have this cue in these items.
findings.recommendation: When GIFT content may change again (a tooling branch or a test baseline update, since authoring/tests/gift-answer-order.test.mjs pins this bank), shorten each correct option or lengthen one distractor so that the lengths are comparable, then rerun authoring/tools/gift/answer-order.mjs.
